text: I use Habitide app for my daily habit tracking. It helps to get motivated each habit, like ,,commiting sport", ,,how much drink you water?" and so many more. With an XP Level feature system, would be grateful when each habit to be rewarded. Each reward brings to the next level. If the task heavier, then the rewarding is better.
author: enes752 / Science of Kingdom /
developer_reply: Thanks for the great feedback! Gamifying habits with scaled XP rewards is an awesome concept. We've noted this down for our development board!
